title: Errors
loadFailed: Failed to load the ontology errors report
noFindings: No errors — every entity, blueprint, and saved query passes the checks.

code.ENUM_MISMATCH: Value not in the allowed list

explain.UNKNOWN_PROPERTY: This property isn't declared where it's used — check the property name, or add it to the blueprint's schema.
explain.COMPUTED_PROPERTY: This id belongs to a mirror, calculation, or aggregation property — a computed value can never be sent as input.
explain.REQUIRED_MISSING: The blueprint marks this property as required — supply a value or make it optional.
explain.TYPE_MISMATCH: The value's type doesn't match the property's declared type — fix the value or the blueprint's schema.
explain.ENUM_MISMATCH: The value isn't one of the property's allowed enum values — pick one from the list or add it to the blueprint.
explain.FORMAT_INVALID: The value doesn't match its declared format (e.g. url, email, date-time) — fix the value.
explain.LENGTH_OUT_OF_RANGE: The value's length falls outside the property's minLength/maxLength bounds — fix the value or the bounds.
explain.PATTERN_MISMATCH: The value doesn't match the property's regular-expression pattern — fix the value or the pattern.
explain.RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: The number falls outside the property's declared minimum/maximum — fix the value or the bounds.
explain.ARRAY_SIZE: The array has fewer or more items than the property's minItems/maxItems allow — adjust the array.
explain.ARRAY_NOT_UNIQUE: The array must hold unique items but contains a duplicate — remove the duplicate.
explain.OBJECT_SHAPE: The object value doesn't match its declared shape (e.g. a labeled-url pair) — fix the value.
explain.UNKNOWN_RELATION: This relation isn't declared where it's used — check the relation name, or add it to the blueprint.
explain.RELATION_SHAPE: The relation is declared single (or many) but the value's shape doesn't match — fix the value or the blueprint.
explain.RELATION_REQUIRED: The blueprint marks this relation as required — supply a target or make it optional.
explain.RELATION_TARGET_MISSING: The relation doesn't resolve to an active entity of the target blueprint — fix the value or restore the target.
explain.TEAM_TARGET_MISSING: The team value doesn't resolve to an active _team entity — fix the value or restore the team.
explain.TEAM_NOT_ALLOWED: A team value was supplied, but this blueprint's ownership is Inherited, so team is computed rather than stored — remove it.
explain.USER_TARGET_MISSING: The value doesn't resolve to an active _user entity — fix the value or restore the user.
explain.OWNERSHIP_UNRESOLVED: This entity's Inherited ownership path resolved to no team — fix the path's relations or give the landing entity a team.
explain.OWNERSHIP_PATH_STALE: The blueprint's ownership path can no longer resolve — a hop names a relation this blueprint lacks or one that allows many, or the path never reaches a Direct/absent-ownership blueprint. Fix the path or the relations it names.
explain.MIRROR_PATH_STALE: This mirror property's path can no longer resolve — a later hop names an unknown relation, an inactive target, or a property the landed blueprint no longer declares. Fix the path.
explain.AGGREGATION_PATH_STALE: This aggregation's path filter can no longer resolve — a hop is malformed, or the chain no longer reaches its declared target. Fix the path filter.
explain.AGGREGATION_PROPERTY_STALE: This aggregation's calculation property or time field no longer names a valid property of the target blueprint — fix the calculation.
explain.CALCULATION_COMPILE_FAILED: This jq expression fails to compile — the message names jq's own error. Fix the expression.
explain.CALCULATION_QUARANTINED: This server instance quarantined the expression after an earlier run missed its evaluation deadline — edit the expression, or wait for a restart, to clear it.
explain.SOURCE_MISSING: This entity or blueprint has no source reference — optional, but without one it cannot be re-synced.
explain.SYNTAX: The query text doesn't parse — check for a missing keyword, bracket, or quote.
explain.UNSUPPORTED: The query uses a feature outside the supported subset of Cypher — see the query language reference for what's accepted.
explain.UNKNOWN_LABEL: The query names a blueprint identifier that doesn't exist — check the spelling or the suggested match.
explain.UNKNOWN_VARIABLE: The query references a pattern variable that was never bound by a MATCH — check the variable name.
explain.DUPLICATE_VARIABLE: The same variable name is bound to two different node patterns — use a distinct name for each.
explain.RELATIONSHIP_VARIABLE_REFERENCE: The query uses a relationship variable beyond what this subset supports — a relationship variable can only be read as r.$tier on a single-hop relationship, and cannot be returned.
explain.RANGE_INVALID: The variable-length relationship's hop range is malformed or exceeds the cap — fix the *min..max bounds.
explain.LIMIT_INVALID: The LIMIT clause isn't a positive integer within the allowed range — fix the value.
explain.DISCONNECTED_PATTERN: The query's patterns share no variable, which would require a cartesian product — connect them, or split into separate queries.
explain.TOO_MANY_PATTERNS: The query has more MATCH patterns than the cap allows — combine or remove some.
explain.TOO_MANY_VARIABLES: The query binds more variables than the cap allows — reduce the number of named nodes.
explain.QUERY_TOO_LONG: The query text is longer than the 2000-character limit — shorten it.
explain.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: The query ran out of its evaluation time budget — narrow the pattern or add more selective filters.
explain.BINDING_LIMIT: The query produced more candidate bindings than the cap allows — narrow the pattern or add a LIMIT.
explain.WORKSPACE_TOO_LARGE: The active workspace is too large for this query to evaluate within the read-memory budget — narrow the filters.

explain.SCHEMA: The mapping document is not well-formed — an unknown member, a wrong type, a null, an unsupported version, a blueprint mapped twice, or the reserved jq codec. Fix the document at the path shown.
explain.UNKNOWN_BLUEPRINT: The mapping names a blueprint that no longer exists — restore the blueprint or remove the pair.
explain.UNKNOWN_PROPERTY: A rule or lossy entry names a property the blueprint does not declare — fix the name or remove it.
explain.UNKNOWN_RELATION: A rule or lossy entry names a relation the blueprint does not declare — fix the name or remove it.
explain.COMPUTED_PROPERTY: A mirror, calculation or aggregation property is named — computed properties are never mapped or declared lossy.
explain.UNKNOWN_KIND: The pair names a kind outside the seven Backstage kinds.
explain.FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: A Backstage address is not a field the pair's kind may carry — check the kind's allowed spec fields.
explain.AMBIGUOUS_SELECTOR: Two pairs for one kind have no selector — give all but one a select.
explain.AMBIGUOUS_REF_PARTITION: Two rules read one spec field into relations that target the same blueprint — import could not tell which rule an entry belongs to; make one export-only or retarget it.
explain.DUPLICATE_IMPORT_TARGET: Two rules that read on import write one Port property, relation or meta field — make one of them export-only (several tagCategory rules into one property are fine).
explain.UNDECLARED_FIELD: A property or relation of the blueprint is neither mapped nor declared lossy — map it or add it to lossy.
explain.CODEC_TYPE_MISMATCH: The rule's codec does not fit its Port or Backstage side, its direction, or its value map is not a bijection.
explain.REQUIRED_UNMAPPED: The kind requires a spec field that no rule writes on export — add a rule or a constant.
explain.VOCABULARY_DRIFT: An enum or value list in the mapping no longer matches the registry list it mirrors — edit the blueprint or the registry so both agree.
explain.REGISTRY_KEY_MISSING: The mapping names a label, annotation key or tag category that is not registered.
explain.REGISTRY_KIND_MISMATCH: The label, annotation key or tag category is registered but does not apply to the pair's kind.
explain.BACKSTAGE_FIELD_UNMAPPED: A field the kind allows is carried by no rule — map it or list it under lossy.backstage.
explain.TARGET_UNMAPPED: A reference points at a blueprint that has no pair in the mapping — map that blueprint to a kind, or drop the rule.
explain.REF_KIND_MISMATCH: The blueprint on the far end of this reference is mapped to a kind the spec field may not reference — check the field or that blueprint's kind.
